title: Class editor TrackSearch likes mode reaches liked songs past the first 200
acceptance: The class editor's TrackSearch "likes" mode shows a way to load liked songs past the first 200 (the X-RitmoFit-Next-Cursor page of GET /providers/:provider/likes), or searches them, instead of stopping at the first page.
Its tests cover a second page for Apple Music and SoundCloud.

evidence.summary: TrackSearch likes mode reads one listLikes page and has no Load more. Checked on main 4206c8c.

Owner decision, Neo session, 2026-11-23 12:44 MST: "Yes, your plan is approved and permissions approved". The approved plan lists RF-149 as Ready (the owner's queue), round 1123's web lane's second PR after RF-130, with implementation, branch, commit, push and draft PRs; merging stays per PR.
Still true on main 3d87b55: likes mode calls listLikes(provider) once (first page, up to 200) and shows no Load more. Likes mode has no text field (the query input renders in search mode only).

This task's PR (not owner-gated). TrackSearch's My likes reads listLikesPage(provider) and, while a next cursor remains, shows Load more songs, which appends listLikesPage(provider, { cursor }) without duplicates (appendSongPage). A failed Load more keeps the loaded rows with 'Couldn’t load more songs: <reason>' and can be retried; a page that lands after a provider, mode or class switch is dropped. Same copy and control as the Music workspace's Songs list (RF-132).

On the Neo, branch head 1640ae4: 'loads apple_music / soundcloud liked songs past the first 200 with Load more' (a 200-song first page with a cursor, then a second page that overlaps by one: 202 rows, the overlap once, the second call carries the cursor, no Load more after the last page); a failed Load more keeps the rows and retries the same cursor; a late page after switching provider is dropped (that test fails with the generation check removed). TrackSearch tests 117/117 with the recovery suite; web suite 1827/1827.

Full AGENTS.md gate on the Neo at 1640ae4: 17 of 18 steps exit 0 (integration 277, build with bundle budget, Playwright smoke 2/2, OpenAPI no diff, contract parity, audit). pnpm test failed once on a timeout in apps/api deploy-script.test.ts (5.9 s against 5 s, at load average 150 to 220 from concurrent work; this PR changes no API code); rerun at load 29: web 1827, API 698, music 30, all passed.

Deployed 2026-11-23 from the Neo in main 1eed288 with scripts/deploy.sh: Worker 515bc8fb-24fd-4ff7-b8be-6f7c28aa1e85 at 100%, SPA assets/index-CFKeSijz.js (3 of 3 propagation fetches). Load more past the first 200 likes in the class editor is live; real paging past 200 likes is still the owner's check.

resolution: The class editor's TrackSearch My likes mode no longer stops at the first page: while GET /providers/:provider/likes returns a next cursor, Load more songs fetches the next page with RF-132's listLikesPage(provider, { cursor }) and appends it without duplicates, for every provider with likes (Apple Music, SoundCloud and Spotify alike). A failed Load more keeps the loaded rows and says why; a late page after a provider, mode or class switch is dropped. Tests cover a second page for Apple Music and SoundCloud. Not used: the Apple server search (listLikesPage({ q })), because likes mode has no text field; adding one would be a new control. No API change. Not checked against real providers: CI uses mock providers.
